tools.name: get_fare_classes
tools.description: What an airline fare class (booking code) means and what it earns, from cwsi.net's fare charts. Give a fare letter (e.g. Delta K) or a Southwest fare name, or leave fare_class out to list them all. Covers Alaska, American, Delta, Hawaiian, JetBlue, Southwest and United.

tools.name: compare_fare_classes
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two fare classes, e.g. Delta K vs United M, from cwsi.net's fare charts. Covers American, Alaska, Delta, Southwest and United.

tools.name: calculate_delta_miles
tools.description: Estimate what a Delta Air Lines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.
